title: pisonia macranthocarpa
intro: Pisonia macranthocarpa, commonly known as the large-fruited pisonia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Nyctaginaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to the treatment of skin conditions and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Pisonia macranthocarpa include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
